verdict.rationale: OpenCode is documented as an open source agent that installs and runs on the user's own machine. `opencode serve` runs a headless HTTP server that a TUI can attach to remotely, and it works with local models. Community users confirm running it via `opencode serve` and with locally hosted models. Missing for 10: a dedicated self-hosting/deployment guide (e.g. containers, licensing details), and a documented way to run fully offline, since a community report says telemetry to OpenCode servers cannot be disabled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent.
The opencode serve command runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint that an opencode client can use.
Attach a terminal to an already running OpenCode backend server started via `serve` or `web` commands.
75+ LLM providers through Models.dev, including local models
You can start a service via 'opencode serve', it can be accessed from anywhere
